page_title: ATA 1-0 VER | Atalanta v Verona 22/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Giovanni Ayroldi is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle and it's Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+2' Amin Sarr (Verona) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' Raffaele Palladino has decided to substitute Marten de Roon and he is replaced by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta).
88' Corner kicks – 2:4. Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 9:14.
85' Substitution. Antoine Bernede (Verona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro walks off.
84' Tomas Suslov (Verona) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
83' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Isak Hien (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Giovanni Ayroldi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

80' A sweet pass finds Gift Orban (Verona) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Marco Carnesecchi is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
79' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
78' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Kieron Bowie as he is replaced by Amin Sarr (Verona).
77' Great chance! Gift Orban (Verona) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies just over the bar.
76' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Charles De Ketelaere will be replaced by Yunus Musah (Atalanta).
76' The referee allows time for a substitution. Sead Kolasinac will be replaced by Isak Hien (Atalanta).
72' Al Musrati (Verona) whips a volley from long range towards the goal. His beautiful effort whistles wide of the left post.
71' Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
68' Total attempts – 12:7. The number of shots on goal at present is 3:2.
66' The manager makes a subsitution with Tomas Suslov (Verona) coming on for Abdou Harroui.
66' Here comes a substitution. Al Musrati (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Roberto Gagliardini.
66' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) attempts to release Davide Zappacosta with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
63' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) replacing Ederson.
63' It's time for a substitution. Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) comes on in place of Nicola Zalewski.
63' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
61' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
60' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the right post.
58' Abdou Harroui (Verona) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.

56' What a chance that is! Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the crossbar!
54' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

50' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
50' Abdou Harroui (Verona) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

48' Kieron Bowie (Verona) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the top right corner. His effort is blocked by Marco Carnesecchi with a brilliant diving save! Verona force their opponents to concede a corner.
46' Abdou Harroui (Verona) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Martin Frese (Verona) comes off for Daniel Oyegoke.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' A crossfield pass from Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
41' A pass from Victor Nelsson (Verona) is intercepted by Marco Carnesecchi and the move breaks down.
40' Martin Frese (Verona) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
37' 1 - 0 Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) picks up the ball on the edge of the penalty box and produces a moment of magic with a brilliant shot that goes into the left side of the goal!
37' Atalanta are seeing far more of the ball now.
35' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) latches onto the free kick from Nicola Zalewski, but heads just over the bar from close range.
32' Abdou Harroui (Verona) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
31' The total number of attempts is 6:2. Shots on target – 2:0.
30' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
28' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
26' Andrias Edmundsson (Verona) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Giovanni Ayroldi signals.
26' Victor Nelsson (Verona) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
24' Gift Orban (Verona) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.

24' A cross from Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. What a miskick by Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
22' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) tries to find Nikola Krstovic with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
20' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) tries his luck but the attempt goes well wide of the right post.
19' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block.

18' Victor Nelsson (Verona) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Giovanni Ayroldi blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Atalanta have a free kick from a promising distance.
17' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) takes the corner which is cleared.
16' Andrias Edmundsson (Verona) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.

16' What a great touch by Ederson (Atalanta) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atalanta.
16' The ratio of the ball possession is 57:43.
15' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

14' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Lorenzo Montipo dived superbly to block a header by Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the right post, but Lorenzo Montipo pulled off a remarkable save!
14' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle after Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Atalanta have a free kick.
10' Ederson (Atalanta) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
8' Kieron Bowie (Verona) commits a foul and Giovanni Ayroldi immediately signals a free kick.
7' A rebound sits up perfectly for Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta), who connects nicely with the ball from mid-range but sends it miles wide of the right post.
7' Neat passing move from Atalanta in order to create new attacking opportunities.
5' The ball is cleared after Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
3' Kieron Bowie (Verona) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
3' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but Lorenzo Montipo comes off his line to gather the ball.
2' Giovanni Ayroldi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta).
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Atalanta will have the kick-off.
Giovanni Ayroldi is introduced as the referee for today's match.
